# Welcome {.unnumbered}

Welcome to the rules of **Quantum Board Game**, a strategy game for 2–4 players
where your pieces can be in two places at once.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
- **Players:** 2–4
- **Playing time:** 30–90 minutes, depending on the level
- **Ages:** 12+
- **Levels:** 5, from first game to expert
:::

## How this book is organised

- **Part I – Core game** explains the aim, the components and the basic rules.
  These apply at every level.
- **Part II – Levels** has one chapter per level. Each chapter only describes
  what that level adds or changes.
- **Appendices** hold the card reference, a one-page quick reference, the FAQ
  and a glossary.

**First time playing?** Read Part I, then play **Level 1** (@sec-level-1).
